objective: Fairly re-vet every currently live model lane with candidate-specific tests; do not tune to pass and do not stress to fail.
decision_rule: A candidate is judged only against tests implied by its own economic claim and data availability. Implementation defects invalidate affected evidence but do not count as scientific failure; corrected frozen science must be rerun.

parsimonious industry momentum/trend selection adds matched-control value

campaign_rule: Run independent lanes in parallel where data/executables already exist. When a lane is blocked by missing authoritative data or roll semantics, record that exact blocker and continue other lanes in the same pass. Consume terminal results into a single survivor board before choosing next tests.
